whatIsIt.eli5: Makes half the notes the normal way and the other half cheaply from the first half.
whatIsIt.simple: A Conv makes half the output channels; a cheap 5×5 depthwise Conv makes 'ghost' channels from them; both halves are joined.
whatIsIt.engineer: cv1 Conv(c1, c2/2, k, s) → cv2 Conv(c2/2, c2/2, 5, 1, g=c2/2) → cat.

whyExists.simple: Feature maps contain many similar channels; generating some cheaply roughly halves the cost.

simple: Normal Conv to half the channels.
engineer: Already in Ultralytics (base_modules); used in yolov8-ghost.yaml.

costNote.eli5: About half the cost of a normal step.
costNote.simple: Roughly halves params and FLOPs vs Conv; already supported by Ultralytics, no stub needed.
